triples.evidence: Origins need hosts: the SDK refuses every request whose Host is not listed, so `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` alone is a start-up error over HTTP
`convert_x3d` on JSON input always runs in the worker thread, and a vrml result expected above 64 MB is refused
`blob_info` and `blob_read` are not limited by it.
Directories (`os.pathsep`-separated) that `blob_put(path=)` may read under, any file name. Unset: scene, data and splat extensions only (see `blob_put`)
`blob_info` and `blob_read` are not limited by it.
